native_runtime.legacy_policy: Trusted PyTorch weight files are converted once with weights_only=True and served from Safetensors.
native_runtime.parity_boundary: The 1.35 GB F5TTS_v1_Base payload is shape/header verified but full real-weight numerical parity is gated by download size. The 54 MB Vocos artifact is hash, tensor-namespace, conversion, and decode verified.

policy: The vendored tree is an auditable reference snapshot only. Production inference and training use VoiceHub-owned native code and never import this source package. Pretrained weights are resolved separately and are not part of the source snapshot.
